purpose: reserved final check after freezing; not a representative real-review evaluation

reviews.text: The toilet continued running all night and its flush handle stuck.
There were greasy fingerprints on the mirror and hairs on the pillow at arrival.
The room stayed very hot because the thermostat would not respond to changes.
We saw insects moving around the breakfast cereal dispenser.
Three calls about missing bed linen were unanswered before we gave up.
The bedside power socket came loose from the wall when we unplugged our charger.
The advertised evening shuttle did not arrive and the desk offered no explanation.
Music from the banquet room carried into our bedroom well past bedtime.
The courtyard was beautiful, but the bathtub drain took almost an hour to empty.
The swimming pool was lovely; crumbs from previous guests remained under our bedside table.
Our welcome was warm, although the air conditioning switched itself off every few minutes.
We enjoyed the terrace, but flies covered the uncovered fruit at breakfast.
A great city location, yet nobody responded when we asked to fix the loose shower rail.
The room was spacious. The fire exit in our corridor was blocked by spare mattresses.
We appreciated the late checkout, but the lift buttons were too high for our wheelchair user.
Friendly staff and tasty coffee, though the breakfast labels did not identify allergens.
Arrival took only a few minutes, and the staff explained every facility clearly.
The room temperature stayed pleasant and the bathroom was thoroughly cleaned.
Our requests for an extra blanket and a wakeup call were both handled promptly.
A restful visit with an excellent evening meal and attentive service.
A dripping tap was repaired as soon as we reported it, and it stayed dry afterwards.
We worried about noise from the nearby road, but heard nothing with the windows closed.
A later gym opening time would suit guests who finish work after dinner.
Nothing else to add.
